title.zh: Agent Decisions Dashboard · 本地开发决策记录与批注看板
title.en: Agent Decisions Dashboard · Local Technical Decision Log & Review Board

summary.zh: 用 Python 标准库和 SQLite 写的本地小看板，用来记录平时和 AI 编程工具讨论过的技术方案、批注修改意见以及历史版本快照。
summary.en: Local dashboard built with the Python standard library and SQLite for recording technical discussions, review comments, and snapshots when working with AI coding tools.

zh: 后端只用 Python 标准库和 SQLite，前端直接打包了 Mermaid 与 Anime.js，不需要安装 npm 依赖即可直接启动
支持在网页上对 Agent 提交的方案逐条打勾、写批注，或者标记为部分同意、推迟再议
带简单的命令行检查脚本和数据库快照恢复功能，防止误改历史记录
en: Uses only the Python standard library and SQLite on the backend, with bundled static frontend assets
Web UI for reviewing proposed plans, adding inline notes, and marking items as accepted or deferred
Includes CLI helper hooks and SQLite snapshot backup/restore

milestone.zh: 日常本地使用中，已完成批注视图、单选问答卡片和快照备份功能。
milestone.en: In daily local use with review annotations, question cards, and snapshot backups.
